clinician.trajectory_summary: A 77-year-old male presented with severe back pain after a mechanical fall. Initial CT of the thoracolumbar spine, performed for the back pain, incidentally revealed an exophytic renal mass (E001). Subsequent dedicated CT of the abdomen and pelvis further characterized this as a right mid pole renal mass, 3.8 cm, with internal septations and a 0.8 cm solid nodular component, classified as a Bosniak type III lesion (E002). A biopsy of this renal mass confirmed the diagnosis of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (E003).

key_supporting_evidence.claim: An exophytic renal mass was incidentally found on initial CT of the lumbar spine.
Dedicated CT characterized the renal mass as a right mid pole lesion, 3.8 cm, with internal septations and a 0.8 cm solid nodular component, classified as Bosniak type III.
Biopsy of the right mid pole renal mass confirmed clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
